title: Crash with global variable

labels.name: semantic-analyzer
labels.description: Problems that happen during semantic analysis

body:
Running mypy-0.641 on
```python
from typing import List  # noqa F401


def foo():
    global bar
    bar = []  # type: List[str]
    bar
```
